title: Monte Carlo Policy Evaluation
seoDescription: Estimate policy state values from complete sampled returns without requiring an environment transition model.
description:
Estimate state-value functions V(s) under a stationary policy from sampled episodic rollouts using first-visit returns.

Monte Carlo methods learn directly from complete experience without requiring Markov transition dynamics.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
V(s) = \frac{1}{N(s)}\sum_{i=1}^{N(s)} G_t^{(i)}(s), \quad G_t = \sum_{k=0}^{T-t-1} \gamma^k R_{t+k+1}
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Traverse episodes backward to compute discounted returns G_t
2. Record returns on first encounter of each state within each episode
3. Average accumulated returns per state across all sampled rollouts

### Returns
Dictionary mapping state identifiers to their estimated value V(s).
